remainingLimitations: No camera/MCU/vehicle connected or flashed; physical grip, placement and vision alignment remain unverified.
First storage lift5 is operator-selected; second layer65 is calculated as5+60. Actual release pose, overlap, clearance and stacking stability remain unverified.

D/E report center/offset, no ring ID. Initial station stop must be near ring2, ROI must lock the intended ring, and the chosen MOVE distance convention plus camera/claw alignment require field validation.
Same-color raw PICK reply has no request ID; delayed same-color reply ambiguity remains.
No grip/servo-arrival sensors. Ground accuracy, collision clearance and worst-case indirect stack use remain unverified.

r18 follows the retained task_disc source, but the running vision firmware was not accessed. Terminal DISC received during a commanded station movement is held until stopped; physical alignment remains unverified. No request IDs distinguish in-flight cross-session late replies.

r20 delegates DISC success to visual ok=1 without pixel-magnitude veto. Actual placement/alignment unverified; camera/vehicle feedback timing remains unresolved and unchanged. Current arm speed/interpolation were pre-existing local edits, not introduced by r20.

r23 wheel RPM does not prove or veto station stop. Advancing after zero-command ACK, settle time and fresh status does not establish physical stillness. Persistent speed-biased host simulations passed; actual wheel motion/noise cause, grip, clearance and physical station behavior remain unverified.

r24 later ring positions use encoder/IMU indexing after one entry visual reference; there is no per-target or departure visual correction. Physical accumulated index error and actual D/E vision software remain unverified.

r28 matches the retained independent vehicle simulation; actual driver acceleration200 and120RPM/s command profiles still require vehicle braking/traction/calibration verification. Host success is not physical acceptance.

r29 may wait indefinitely when real feedback/vision never returns. Missing motion data temporarily commands zero; this is not blind motion and not removal of all protection. Automatic continuation after valid data requires field acceptance.
r30 faster turn gains and concurrent platform/yaw motion passed independent host models; physical braking, clearance and loaded servo arrival remain unverified.
Observed DISC,353,161,33,0 indicates terminal visual failure. r33 accepts mismatched dx/cx with ok1; terminal ok0 still cannot confirm alignment. Actual vision board software has not been accessed.
r31 storage second pickup100mm is operator selected; actual cup grip height and physical pickup still require vehicle verification. Vision alignment was explicitly left unchanged.
r32 screen has not been downloaded or connected; local frames/build and matching existing TFT do not establish real display behavior, voltage compatibility or refresh timing.
Old code does not label physical wheel positions. HMI wheel mapping defaults0 and displays unknown; synthetic1/2/3/4 mapping in host tests is not calibration.
No grip/servo-arrival or voltage measurement supports success counters or confirmed idle mechanism arrival. Unknown values are intentional, not field measurements.
Existing TFT hides vision dx/dy when color=0; D/E has no color, so station correction logs remain the ring-offset diagnostic.
USART6 is TX-only with bkcmd0; displayed data may remain stale if the screen is disconnected. There is no screen-ACK or physical link guarantee.
1px/mm is an operator assumption, not measured calibration.
F returns only center coordinates, without color/fallback-source/success marker; camera fallback center cannot prove a same-color base.
No request ID distinguishes a late reply crossing two F sessions.
Physical pickup, release, restored index reference and stacking stability remain unverified.
1px/mm is operator-assumed, not measured calibration.
STACK contains no success/color/fallback-source marker, and there is no visual remeasurement after correction.
Physical camera polarity, chassis travel, axis coupling, return accuracy and stacking remain unverified.
